app_fee.value: The Graduate School's standard application fee for international applicants is $60 (non-refundable).
app_fee.quote: Graduate School's standard fee is $50 for domestic applicants and $60 for international applicants. Certain programs have higher fees which will be assessed at the time of application. The application fee is non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: No fee-waiver rule was found on the fetched catalog pages.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not require GRE scores; each program decides, so see the program record.
gre_general.quote: Standardized academic test scores are not required by the Graduate School; however, they may be required by the academic program.

toefl_min.value: The Graduate School's minimum required TOEFL score is 4.0 on the new scale.

ielts_min.value: The Graduate School's minimum required IELTS score is 6.5.

english_waiver.value: English test waivers require a degree earned in the US with GPA >= 3.0 or citizenship in an exempt English-speaking country; India is not listed and medium-of-instruction waivers are not granted.
english_waiver.quote: The applicant has earned a bachelor's, graduate, or professional degree in the United States with a GPA of 3.00 or higher. | The applicant is a citizen of one of the following countries: | Antigua | Australia | Bahamas | Barbados | Belize | Bermuda | Botswana | Cameroon | Canada, with the exception of Quebec | Cayman Islands | Ghana | Irish Republic | Jamaica | Kenya | Malawi | New Zealand | Nigeria | Rwanda | Sierra Leone | South Africa | Tanzania | Trinidad & Tobago | Uganda | United Kingdom (England, Scotland, Ireland, Wales) | Zambia | Zimbabwe

notes: Graduate application fee $60, TOEFL 4.0, IELTS 6.5 from the international graduate admissions page. GRE requirements are set at the program level.
